title: Perez's offer from Chicago and Big Eye Louis who faked reading
summary: Perez sent Charles a ticket to join a Creole band on the Orpheum circuit; he describes Big Eye Louis Nelson, who could not read a note.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene
